notes: Leads, Contracts And Suppliers: The record windows are laid out like the Inventory window: each part is a numbered card, every box has its name above it, and the boxes sit in tidy columns.
Fewer Cards: The main details of a lead or contract are in one card at the top, and Supply Only, On Hold and Cancelled share one line.
Address Window: Customer, phone numbers, email and the addresses use the same cards.
